dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です本日は申し訳ありませんでした
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. I apologize for the trouble today.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: いえいえ、無事に開始できてよかったです(*^^*)本日はよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: No problem at all, I'm glad we could start without any issues. I look forward to our session today.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございますそれでは始めたいと思います
dialogue.English: Thank you. Let's begin.

dialogue.content: はい、よろしくお願いします。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: こんばんは相談員です。本日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, this is the counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 仕事のことで悩んでいます。
dialogue.English: I’m struggling with something related to my work.

dialogue.content: そうなんですねお仕事それは大変ですね
dialogue.English: I see. Work issues... that sounds difficult.

dialogue.content: どのようなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me what's been happening?

dialogue.content: 今の仕事を退職して、飲食店を始めたいのですが、周囲の反対もあり迷っています。
dialogue.English: I want to quit my current job and start a restaurant, but I’m hesitant because of opposition from people around me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねそれは、悩ましいですね
dialogue.English: I see. That’s a difficult dilemma.

dialogue.content: はい…
dialogue.English: Yes…

dialogue.content: 周囲の方はどのように反対されているのですか？
dialogue.English: How are the people around you expressing their opposition?

dialogue.content: 家族もいるのに、生活はどうするんだと言われてます。
dialogue.English: They're asking me how I'm going to support my family.

dialogue.content: はい家族・・・それは困惑してしまいますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, family... That must be very confusing for you.

dialogue.content: どなたがそのように言われているのですか？
dialogue.English: Who specifically is saying that?

dialogue.content: 父です
dialogue.English: My father.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・なんとも複雑な気持ちになってしまいますね
dialogue.English: I see… That must bring up some complicated feelings.

dialogue.content: そうですね…言ってることはわかるのですが…
dialogue.English: Yes... I understand what he's saying, but...

dialogue.content: はいそうなのですねでも、やりたかったことなのですよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I see. But this is something you've wanted to do, isn't it?

dialogue.content: いつごろからやりたいと思われていたのですか？
dialogue.English: How long have you wanted to do this?

dialogue.content: そうなんです、長年の夢だったので。
dialogue.English: Yes, it's been a long-held dream of mine.

dialogue.content: ずっとずっと前からです
dialogue.English: For a very, very long time.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: なんとしても実現したいですね
dialogue.English: You must really want to make it happen.

dialogue.content: はい。でも周囲の言い分もわかるので、踏み切れないです
dialogue.English: Yes. But I also understand where the people around me are coming from, so I can’t take the plunge.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね周りにも賛成してほしいですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. You'd like the people around you to support your decision, wouldn't you?

dialogue.content: ほかの周りの方はどのような感じなのですか？
dialogue.English: What about the other people around you? How do they feel?

dialogue.content: でも皆賛成してくれたら、逆に不安になるかもです。
dialogue.English: But if everyone agreed, I think I would actually feel anxious instead.

dialogue.content: はいなんか少しわかります
dialogue.English: Yes, I think I understand that a little.

dialogue.content: ええ。周りの言い分は、自分の不安でもあるので。
dialogue.English: Yes. What they’re saying also reflects my own anxieties.

dialogue.content: 鏡のように感じてしまわれているのですねそれは、苦しいですね
dialogue.English: So you feel like it's a mirror reflecting your own anxieties. That must be painful.

dialogue.content: 長年の夢とのことですが今回やれそうになったいきさつはどのようなことがあったのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned it's a long-held dream. What circumstances have made it seem possible to pursue it now?

dialogue.content: 鏡か…そうですね。結局は自分との戦いですよね
dialogue.English: A mirror… yes, that's right. In the end, it's a battle with myself, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 子供が独立して、養うのは妻だけになったので。
dialogue.English: My children have become independent, so now I only have my wife to support.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですねそれは心機一転なにかやりたい気持ちにもなりますね
dialogue.English: I see. That makes sense that you'd feel like it's time for a fresh start and want to do something new.

dialogue.content: 妻もパートをしてますし、なんとかなるのではないかと思って。
dialogue.English: My wife works part-time as well, so I thought we could manage somehow.

dialogue.content: 今しかないと思いました…
dialogue.English: I felt that it’s now or never…

dialogue.content: はいそうなのですねそれは心強いですよね確かに　今って感じがしますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, I see. That is reassuring. It certainly does feel like now is the time, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: どのようなお店とお考えなのですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of restaurant are you thinking of opening?

dialogue.content: 中華料理屋さんをしたいと思ってます。
dialogue.English: I'd like to open a Chinese restaurant.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねずっと前からの夢だったんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So it's been a dream for a very long time.

dialogue.content: はい、皆に美味しい料理を食べてもらいたくて。
dialogue.English: Yes, I want everyone to enjoy my delicious food.

dialogue.content: はい皆さんの笑顔を想像しますよね
dialogue.English: Yes, you can just imagine everyone's smiling faces.

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: 今はどのようなお仕事をされていらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: What kind of work are you doing now?

dialogue.content: ホワイトカラーのサラリーマンです。
dialogue.English: I’m a white-collar office worker.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・だいぶ変わってしまうのですね
dialogue.English: I see… so it would be a very big change.

dialogue.content: 確かに決断をするのは勇気がいりますよね
dialogue.English: It certainly takes courage to make that decision.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そのホワイトカラーのサラリーマンに対してはどのような思いでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: How do you feel about your job as a white-collar office worker?

dialogue.content: 安定した収入のおかげで子供を育てられましたから、感謝しています
dialogue.English: I'm grateful for it, because the stable income allowed me to raise my children.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね・・・それでは余計不安が出てきてしまいますね
dialogue.English: I see... That must make the anxiety even greater.

dialogue.content: 妻さんはどのようにおっしゃっているのですか？
dialogue.English: What does your wife say about it?

dialogue.content: そうですね、かなり気がかりです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's a big worry.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: うーん、妻はフルタイムでバリバリ働きたくないみたいなので、なんとも言えない顔をしてます
dialogue.English: Well, my wife doesn't seem to want to work full-time with high intensity, so she just makes a noncommittal face about it.

dialogue.content: ・・・そうなのですねお店のお手伝いなどに関してはお話などされてますか？
dialogue.English: ...I see. Have you talked to her about things like helping out at the restaurant?

dialogue.content: 奥様も人生が大きく変わる気がすると不安になってしまうかもしれないですね
dialogue.English: Perhaps your wife is also feeling anxious, sensing that her life will change significantly as well.

dialogue.content: うーん、話しづらいですね。妻もこんな感じだし、自分一人で切り盛りしようかと思ってます。
dialogue.English: Hmm, it’s hard to talk about it with her. Given her reaction, I’m thinking of running the restaurant by myself.

dialogue.content: そうですね…仕方ないですよね
dialogue.English: Yes... I guess it can't be helped.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね奥様に迷惑をかけたくないのですね
dialogue.English: I see. You don't want to burden your wife.

dialogue.content: 本音を言えば妻も自立して欲しいのですが…
dialogue.English: To be honest, I’d like my wife to be more independent, too…

dialogue.content: そうなのですね
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自立というとどのようなイメージでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: When you say "independent," what kind of image do you have in mind?

dialogue.content: 1人で生きていける分くらいは、稼いで欲しいなと。自分の稼ぎを当てにされると、お店をやると苦しいので…
dialogue.English: I’d like her to earn enough to support herself. If she has to rely on my income, it will be difficult to run the restaurant…

dialogue.content: そうですよねお互いに自立できていると心配が減りますよね
dialogue.English: That's right. If you're both financially independent, there's less to worry about, isn't there?

dialogue.content: そうなんです。
dialogue.English: Exactly.

dialogue.content: なので、心残りです。
dialogue.English: So, that's a lingering concern of mine.

dialogue.content: 夢を実現するか今まで通りで行くか本当に悩まれますね
dialogue.English: It's a truly difficult choice between realizing your dream and continuing as you are.

dialogue.content: はい、本当に悩みます
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm really struggling with it.

dialogue.content: お子様はどのような感じですか？
dialogue.English: What about your children?

dialogue.content: 好きなことをやればいいと言っています。もう自立しているので、いい意味で関係ないって感じです。
dialogue.English: They say I should do what I love. They're independent now, so in a good way, it doesn't really concern them.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねお互いに自立しようという感じなのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So there's a sense of mutual independence there.

dialogue.content: ええ、子供たちには感謝しています
dialogue.English: Yes, I’m grateful to my children.

dialogue.content: うれしいですよね
dialogue.English: That’s heartening, isn’t it?

dialogue.content: 当てにされるのが、私は存外辛かったのかもしれません。
dialogue.English: Perhaps being relied upon was unexpectedly difficult for me.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねもともとお互いに自立していたかった？という感じですか？
dialogue.English: I see. Is it a case of you always having wanted both of you to be independent?

dialogue.content: うーん、どうでしょう…過去のことは今となってはわかりませんが、子供も独立した今は、妻ももう少し働けるのではないかと思ってます。
dialogue.English: Hmm, I'm not sure... I can't say for certain about the past, but now that the children are independent, I feel my wife could probably work a little more.

dialogue.content: 今はもっと自由になれる気持ちがするのですね
dialogue.English: So you feel that you can be freer now.

dialogue.content: そうですね、そんな気持ちです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s how I feel.

dialogue.content: カウンセラーさん、すごいですね
dialogue.English: You're amazing, counselor.

dialogue.content: はい？
dialogue.English: Oh?

dialogue.content: 言われてみれば、そんな気持ちだなと思いました
dialogue.English: Now that you say it, I realize that's exactly how I feel.

dialogue.content: そういうことですねはい良かったです
dialogue.English: So that's it. Yes, I'm glad.

dialogue.content: これからまだ先がありますしお互いに尊重しあって過ごしたいと思います
dialogue.English: You still have a long future ahead of you, and I believe it's a time to live with mutual respect.

dialogue.content: そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you're right.

dialogue.content: お父様のことに戻らせていただきたいのですが
dialogue.English: I’d like to return to the topic of your father, if that’s alright.

dialogue.content: お父様とは現在どのような関係でいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: What is your current relationship with your father like?

dialogue.content: あまり普段は連絡をとりません。厳格な父です
dialogue.English: We don't usually keep in touch much. He's a very strict father.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね厳格・・・
dialogue.English: I see... strict...

dialogue.content: それでは今回のことも言いにくい気持ちがおありだったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that make it hard for you to talk to him about this topic?

dialogue.content: 昔ながらの人なので、妻を養うものと思ってると思います
dialogue.English: He’s old-fashioned, so I think he believes it's a husband's duty to support his wife.

dialogue.content: そういう感じを抱いているのですねそれは、心苦しいですよね
dialogue.English: So that's the impression you have. That must be difficult for you.

dialogue.content: 説明もしにくいですよね
dialogue.English: It makes it hard to explain, doesn't it?

dialogue.content: ええ…分かり合えませんから。この部分は
dialogue.English: Yes… We just can’t see eye to eye on this issue.

dialogue.content: 妻も煮え切らない態度ですし。
dialogue.English: And my wife is being noncommittal, too.

dialogue.content: はい・・・ちなみにお母様はどのような感じなのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... By the way, what about your mother?

dialogue.content: 父に強く言えませんが、好きなことをやればいいと思ってくれてると思います。父の手前あまり面と向かって言えませんが。
dialogue.English: She can’t stand up to my father, but I think she believes I should do what I want. She just can't say it openly in front of him, though.

dialogue.content: そうなのですねそのようなご夫婦なのですねでも心強いですね
dialogue.English: I see, so that's the dynamic between them. Still, her quiet support is reassuring, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、とても。
dialogue.English: Yes, very much so.

dialogue.content: 今までのところを一旦まとめさせていただいてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I took a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 今相談者さんは長年の夢　中華料理店を開く夢をかなえるべくサラリーマンを辞めるか悩んでいらっしゃる
dialogue.English: Right now, you're struggling with the decision of whether to quit your office job to fulfill your long-held dream of opening a Chinese restaurant.

dialogue.content: お父様は家族の面倒を見ることを心配され奥様はご自身の生活が変わることに不安げで相談者さんとしては悩ましくなってしまっている
dialogue.English: Your father is worried about you providing for your family, and your wife seems anxious about her own life changing, which leaves you feeling troubled by it all.

dialogue.content: お子さんとお母様は陰ながら応援される雰囲気で
dialogue.English: Meanwhile, your children and your mother seem to be quietly supporting you.

dialogue.content: ご自身もこれから本当に自分がやりたかったことを今ならできると考えていらっしゃる
dialogue.English: And you yourself feel that now is the time you can finally do what you've always wanted to do.

dialogue.content: 決断するのにとても勇気が必要なことだと思いました
dialogue.English: I can see that this is a decision that requires a great deal of courage.

dialogue.content: 今までしっかりご家族を守られたからこそ今の思いが大きくなっているのだと思いました
dialogue.English: And I believe it's precisely because you've taken such good care of your family up to this point that this desire has grown so strong.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: いかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How does that sound?

dialogue.content: もう少しお伺いしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I ask you a few more questions?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.content: 長い間お夢とおっしゃっていましたが資金面や計画などどのような感じでいらっしゃるのですか？
dialogue.English: You mentioned this has been your dream for a long time. What is the situation regarding funding and planning?

dialogue.content: 開業資金はあります。土地はこれからですが、見つからないことはないと思います。これからは贅沢せず堅実に生活するようになると思います
dialogue.English: I have the startup capital. I still need to find a location, but I don't think it will be impossible. From now on, I expect we'll have to live more modestly and frugally.

dialogue.content: お店を開業したら、ですね。
dialogue.English: Once I open the restaurant, that is.

dialogue.content: さすがにそれ以上の蓄えはないので。
dialogue.English: I don't have any savings beyond that, though.

dialogue.content: 開業資金も準備され・・・すごいですね
dialogue.English: You’ve even prepared the start-up capital… that’s impressive.

dialogue.content: ただ家の貯金なので、妻の了承なしには使えませんが…
dialogue.English: However, it's our household savings, so I can't use it without my wife's consent…

dialogue.content: そうなのですね今までも堅実に過ごされたからこその貯金だと思います
dialogue.English: I see. I imagine those savings are the result of having lived so prudently up to this point.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 妻の了解も必要だと思いますが、ご自身の大切な財産だと思います
dialogue.English: I agree that your wife's approval is necessary, but I also think it's your own precious asset.

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 私の思ったことをお伝えしてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: May I share a thought that occurred to me?

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: 長年にわったってしっかりお仕事をされ貯金もできお子様も自立されこれまでの責任はすべて果たされていると思いました
dialogue.English: It seems to me that you have worked hard for many years, built up savings, and seen your children become independent. You've fulfilled all of your responsibilities up to this point.

dialogue.content: 奥様への思いも、十分納得できる気がします
dialogue.English: Your feelings about your wife also seem completely understandable.

dialogue.content: ただ、奥様のことを心配されるあまりに少し会話が足りていないのではないかということが気になりました
dialogue.English: However, I was a little concerned that perhaps out of worry for your wife, there hasn't been enough communication between you.

dialogue.content: 確かに…
dialogue.English: That’s true…

dialogue.content: 後ろめたく思うことはないと思います
dialogue.English: I don't think you have anything to feel guilty about.

dialogue.content: もう少し具体的なお店の計画などを立ててみてそのお話をされてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: How about creating a more concrete plan for the restaurant and then discussing that plan with her?

dialogue.content: 具体的な計画を見ていくことで奥様からはしっかりした本音が聞き出せるかもしれません
dialogue.English: By looking at a concrete plan together, you might be able to hear your wife's true, honest feelings.

dialogue.content: また相談者さんの本気度が伝わる気がします
dialogue.English: It would also convey just how serious you are about this.

dialogue.content: そうですね、家計のことは妻の方が得意ですから、しっかり話し合った方がいいかもしれません。
dialogue.English: You're right. My wife is better with household finances, so it would probably be best to discuss it thoroughly with her.

dialogue.content: 資金繰りなど、考えられることは自分でも考えてみます
dialogue.English: I'll also try to think through what I can on my own, like cash flow and other financial matters.

dialogue.content: 相談者さんはとてもやさしい方なので、大変かもしれませんが
dialogue.English: You seem like a very kind person, so it might be difficult, but...

dialogue.content: 現実感が出てくる方が動き出せると思います
dialogue.English: I think making the plan more concrete and realistic will help you to start moving forward.

dialogue.content: なるほど。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 自分にももっと自信がついてくると思います
dialogue.English: I believe you'll become more confident in yourself as well.

dialogue.content: ぜひ取り組んでみてほしいと思いますがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I would really encourage you to try tackling this. What do you think?

dialogue.content: そうですね…状況を変えるためには、話し合うしかないのだと思います
dialogue.English: You're right… I think the only way to change the situation is to talk it through.

dialogue.content: 怖いですが、やってみます
dialogue.English: It’s scary, but I’ll give it a try.

dialogue.content: はい勇気を出して正直に気持ちをぶつけてみましょう
dialogue.English: Yes, let's summon your courage and share your feelings honestly.

dialogue.content: わかりました。
dialogue.English: I will.

dialogue.content: お父様の方は私が言うのもなんですがお母様に任せておけばよいかと思ってしまいました
dialogue.English: As for your father, it may not be my place to say, but I had the thought that perhaps you could leave that to your mother.

dialogue.content: 確かにそうですね（笑）
dialogue.English: That's true (laughs).

dialogue.content: あまり気にしないことにします
dialogue.English: I’ll try not to worry about it too much.

dialogue.content: 父は我が家に関係ありませんから。
dialogue.English: My father isn't really a part of our household, anyway.

dialogue.content: 長年の夢をかなえるために今できそうなことを頑張ってみてください
dialogue.English: Please do your best with what you can right now to make your long-held dream come true.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you.

dialogue.content: 関係ないことはないですが今は、ご自身の本当に大切なところだと思います
dialogue.English: It's not that he's completely unrelated, of course, but right now, I think you should focus on what's truly important to you.

dialogue.content: 心配されていることだけは感謝してあげてくださいね
dialogue.English: Do try, at least, to be grateful for his concern for you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, you’re right.

dialogue.content: ぜひ奥様に伝わる計画を作ってみてください
dialogue.English: Please try to create a plan that will truly resonate with your wife.

dialogue.content: はい！
dialogue.English: I will!

dialogue.content: このような感じですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So, that's the general direction we've discussed. How are you feeling about it?

dialogue.content: 少し勇気が湧いてきたのと、わくわくしてきました
dialogue.English: I feel a bit more courageous, and I'm starting to get excited.

dialogue.content: それは良かったです応援しています
dialogue.English: I'm so glad to hear that. I’m rooting for you.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: それでは本日はこれで終わりにさせていただいてよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Shall we wrap up our session for today?

dialogue.content: はい、大丈夫です。ありがとうございました！
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine. Thank you very much!

dialogue.content: こちらこそ楽しいお話ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for the enjoyable conversation.

dialogue.content: それでは終了させていただきます
dialogue.English: I will end the session now.
